# `cftc_comment_files`

**Selected CFTC comment files**

One selected comment-file observation, retaining its declared file association and recorded provider evidence.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained listing observations, with detail and file acquisition only where explicitly selected. Listing-only records preserve their unselected detail state; broader rule coverage requires separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `cftc_comment_files.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity of this selected source observation. |
| `rule_observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity joining this occurrence to its selected rule observation. |
| `filename` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated file name. |
| `file_url` | `VARCHAR` | Source-declared selected file URI. |
| `body_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the selected resource or archive-member bytes. |
| `pdf_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version stated by the retained PDF header; a byte-format observation. |
| `provider_evidence_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original recorded provider evidence for the selected file, separate from file bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `comment_id` | `BIGINT` | Source-stated CFTC comment identifier. |
| `rule_id` | `BIGINT` | Source-stated CFTC rule identifier. |
| `file_id` | `BIGINT` | Source file identifier where stated; SEC uses a reader-generated resource identity. |
| `bytes` | `BIGINT` | Exact selected resource or member byte size. |
